mi.title: XXMI Launcher
mi.directoryHint: Stored in data beside QAQR by default. Updates preserve Mods and existing settings.
mi.completed: Components installed and verified; paths updated
mi.componentMissing: The embedded XXMI installer is missing. Rebuild or reinstall QAQR.
mi.invalidComponent: The embedded XXMI installer failed verification
mi.unsupported: This game or component does not support XXMI installation
mi.timeout: The installer timed out. Check the connection and try again.
mi.busy: Another XXMI operation is in progress. Try again later.
mi.saveFailed: Components were installed, but QAQR could not save the paths. Select them again.
mi.recoveryRequired: Automatic rollback is incomplete. Recovery files are preserved at {{path}}. Close the locking program and restore the files before updating again.
mi.legacyMigrationDeferred: Migration could not finish. The original directory remains in use; restart after resolving the issue to retry. {{error}}

fork.title: QAQR maintained MI
fork.runtimeDescription: Incremental Mod-state saving and the activity memory channel.
fork.efmiDescription: Incremental saving, activity detection, and the EFMI skeleton-buffer compatibility repair.
fork.approvalHint: In XXMI Launcher, select this game, enable Unsafe Mode in Advanced Settings, and save. This permits custom DLLs for this MI and skips the upstream DLL signature check.
fork.restartHint: The new runtime takes effect when the game starts again. F10 does not replace a loaded DLL.
fork.applied: Maintained files applied. Restart the game to use them.
fork.restored: Previous files restored. Restart the game; Unsafe Mode can be adjusted in the Launcher.
fork.unsupported: This game is not covered by the maintained MI builds.
fork.notInitialized: First install and configure this game’s MI in XXMI Launcher.
fork.bundleMissing: The maintained MI bundle is missing. Update or rebuild QAQR.
fork.invalidBackup: The MI recovery record failed verification.
fork.approvalRequired: Enable and save Unsafe Mode for this game in XXMI Launcher before applying a custom runtime.
fork.modified: These MI files changed outside QAQR. Review them before applying or restoring another build.
fork.unknownRuntime: The current DLL is outside this build’s verified compatibility baseline. No files were changed.
fork.unknownCore: The installed EFMI Core is outside this build’s compatibility baseline. No files were changed.
fork.writeFailed: An MI file could not be replaced or verified.
fork.recoveryRequired: An interrupted operation needs recovery. Backups are preserved at {{path}}.
fork.noBackup: There is no maintained-build backup for this MI.

language.unsupported: This language is not available yet

gameVisibility.title: Game visibility
gameVisibility.description: Turn off a game to hide it from the sidebar, Mod state, download filters, and other game lists. Settings, downloads, and Mods are retained. Turn it on to restore visibility.
gameVisibility.keepVisible: Keep at least one game visible

game.officialLauncherHint: Official launch opens this program without loading Mods. Select launcher.exe or NTELauncher.exe if automatic detection is incorrect.
